opportunities.name: AWS Activate Founders
opportunities.summary: Cloud credits for eligible self-funded startups, including eligible Bedrock usage.
opportunities.eligibility: Self-funded; founded in the last ten years; working website; new to Activate.
opportunities.limits: Select startups may qualify for up to US$5,000. Country eligibility and award terms need checking.

opportunities.name: AWS Activate Portfolio
opportunities.summary: Cloud credit for provider-backed startups; eligible Bedrock models are covered.
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-Series B; founded in the last ten years; an Activate Provider organisation ID is required.
opportunities.limits: Prior awards affect the available amount; invitation-only AI credits are separate. Check country, service and expiry terms.

opportunities.name: Google Cloud Start
opportunities.summary: Entry-level Google Cloud credits for early-stage startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Working MVP, business model and plans to seek venture funding; subject to review.
opportunities.limits: The Start tier is distinct from funded Scale tiers. Credits cover eligible Google services, not third-party Marketplace models.

opportunities.name: Google Cloud Scale AI
opportunities.value: Up to US$350,000 over two years
opportunities.summary: Credit for qualifying venture-funded AI-first startups using Google Cloud.
opportunities.eligibility: Qualifying venture funding, company age and prior credit limits apply.
opportunities.limits: Year one covers eligible usage up to $250K; year two covers 20% of spend up to $100K. Third-party model credits are separate.

opportunities.name: Microsoft for Startups
opportunities.summary: Azure credits and startup support with additional milestones.
opportunities.eligibility: Privately held, for-profit software product startup before Series C; country and business verification apply.
opportunities.limits: Higher amounts have workload, usage or investor conditions. Only eligible models sold and billed by Azure are covered; third-party-billed models can be excluded.

opportunities.name: Oracle Cloud Free Trial
opportunities.summary: OCI trial and limited Always Free services.
opportunities.eligibility: New eligible trial customers; card verification required.
opportunities.limits: Trial credit is not verified as unrestricted generative AI inference credit. Trial and Always Free limits differ.

opportunities.name: OpenAI for Startups
opportunities.summary: API credits may be available through participating VC partners.
opportunities.eligibility: Qualifying VC relationship and referral process; ask the provider or your investor.
opportunities.limits: No universal public amount established; an Australian partnership announcement is historical and does not prove current award terms.

opportunities.name: Claude for Startups
opportunities.value: Up to US$100,000 via partner VC
opportunities.summary: A partner-backed route to additional first-party Claude API credits.
opportunities.eligibility: VC partner affiliation for the larger award.
opportunities.limits: The research recorded the public startup cohort as full; verify current intake. Credits do not transfer to Bedrock or Vertex AI.

opportunities.name: xAI Startups
opportunities.summary: A discretionary API credit programme for qualifying startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Venture backing, live product and a company-domain email.
opportunities.limits: No fixed public maximum; grant and expiry terms are specified by the award.

opportunities.name: Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst
opportunities.summary: Selected AI startups may receive Model Studio tokens and cloud benefits.
opportunities.eligibility: Selection and service-specific conditions apply.
opportunities.limits: The headline cloud credit and token offer are conditional; verify country, currency, model scope and current campaign terms.

opportunities.name: BytePlus VStart
opportunities.summary: Cloud coupons and selected AI benefits for qualifying startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Round D or earlier and programme selection criteria.
opportunities.limits: The published headline benefits may overlap. Confirm model coverage, expiry and geographic eligibility.

opportunities.name: NVIDIA Inception
opportunities.summary: A no-equity startup programme with technical resources and partner offers.
opportunities.eligibility: Australian page specifies incorporation, less than ten years, a working website and at least one developer.
opportunities.limits: Partner offers have their own eligibility tests. Membership does not imply a specific OpenAI or Claude grant.

opportunities.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
opportunities.summary: Inference and compute credit tiers for selected startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Award tiers depend on funding raised; programme approval required.
opportunities.limits: Service exclusions apply. Confirm country eligibility and expiry in the award.

opportunities.name: Baseten Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Dedicated inference/training and separate Model API credits for eligible AI startups.
opportunities.eligibility: AI-first, VC-backed Seed–Series A, under five years, with prior-credit and paid-plan restrictions.
opportunities.limits: The published components have different service scopes; six-month expiry. Check country eligibility.

opportunities.name: DeepInfra DeepStart
opportunities.summary: Inference credits for qualifying early-stage startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Direct route specifies company age and funding thresholds; an NVIDIA Inception route has different conditions.
opportunities.limits: The 50-billion-token headline is price-dependent, not 50 billion tokens on every model. One grant per company.

opportunities.name: Modal for Startups
opportunities.summary: GPU compute credits for selected startups.
opportunities.eligibility: New customer and funding or partner conditions vary by tier.
opportunities.limits: Amount, expiry and country eligibility need confirmation. The free Starter plan is separate.

opportunities.name: Cerebras Early Access
opportunities.summary: Selected early-access applicants may receive free credits.
opportunities.eligibility: Apply for early access; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: The separate trial has its own amount and conditions; do not assume a specific startup award.

opportunities.name: Fireworks Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Startup Build Credits for AI inference and related services.
opportunities.eligibility: Programme admission and current terms should be checked.
opportunities.limits: The current public landing page does not establish a single award amount or term.

opportunities.name: Nebius for Startups
opportunities.summary: Startup support through eligible venture-capital partners.
opportunities.eligibility: Current research indicates a VC-partner route and at least US$5M raised.
opportunities.limits: Older promotional awards do not establish a current grant. Confirm amount, country and expiry.

opportunities.name: Devin for Startups
opportunities.summary: Initial credit after approval, with additional matched credits available.
opportunities.eligibility: Application and approval; confirm country, currency and award expiry.
opportunities.limits: The maximum US$65K headline includes up to US$50K in 1:1 matched credits, which requires US$50K of customer spending to unlock fully.

opportunities.name: GitHub for Startups
opportunities.summary: Credits for eligible GitHub Enterprise Cloud products, including Copilot.
opportunities.eligibility: Approved partner and outside funding; at or before Series B; other prior-use restrictions apply.
opportunities.limits: A payment method and paid billing after expiry or exhaustion may apply. Check the full award terms.

opportunities.name: Vercel Startup Program
opportunities.summary: A flexible commitment amount for eligible startups, with Enterprise-tier access for up to one year.
opportunities.eligibility: Approved partner affiliation, Series A or earlier, application within 12 months of the latest funding round, and no previous programme credits.
opportunities.limits: For startups accepted from 6 August 2026: a payment method is required; after the allowance is exhausted or the year ends, standard rates apply. AI Gateway has a 50% cap and excess usage is billed. Earlier grants follow different terms and exclude AI Gateway and v0.

facts.Billing: Payment method required; standard rates after benefits
facts.AI Gateway: 50% cap for current offer; earlier grants excluded

opportunities.name: Replit for Startups
opportunities.summary: Platform credit and a Pro offer advertised through partner channels.

opportunities.name: Blackbird Giants
opportunities.summary: Founder programme for early startup ideas with an ANZ connection.

opportunities.name: Vercel AI Accelerator

opportunities.name: Blackbird investment

opportunities.name: Temporal Cloud Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Temporal Cloud Business plan credits and support for eligible funded startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Raised US$30 million or less within the past three years; a Temporal Cloud account with a first workflow and active usage is required.
opportunities.limits: Credits are offered for one year, subject to approval. Confirm geographic eligibility, covered usage and any charges after credits expire.

facts.Funding: Up to US$30 million in past three years

opportunities.name: Temporal Cloud for AWS Activate
opportunities.summary: A separate Temporal Cloud offer for AWS Activate startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Exclusive to AWS Activate startups, subject to programme approval.
opportunities.limits: This is a separate offer from the direct US$6,000 programme; do not assume they can be combined. Confirm expiry, charges and geographic eligibility.

opportunities.name: First Nations Pre-Accelerator NSW
opportunities.summary: Mentoring and training for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander founders exploring an early-stage business or startup idea.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicants identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, have a NSW base or connection or clear intent to serve NSW communities or customers, and have an idea or early-stage business.
opportunities.limits: The programme includes online materials and 12 months of aftercare. Expressions of interest were open at review; confirm current intake, participation and any costs.

opportunities.name: First Nations Women’s Diversity Pre-Accelerator NSW
opportunities.summary: Structured learning and mentoring for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander women exploring business ideas in NSW.
opportunities.eligibility: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander women across NSW; a registered business, business plan or fully developed idea is not required.
opportunities.limits: The programme includes online masterclasses and a three-day in-person intensive. Expressions of interest were open at review; confirm current intake, location and any costs.

opportunities.name: LUinc. Business Startup Accelerator
opportunities.summary: Coaching, training, networking and shared workspace for early-stage entrepreneurs in Leicester and Leicestershire.
opportunities.eligibility: The operator lists alternative eligibility criteria, including living, working or recently studying in the area, or a new locally registered business within 12 months of setup; consult the full criteria.
opportunities.limits: GOV.UK describes businesses trading less than 12 months, including pre-trading businesses, in Leicester and Leicestershire. The operator also lists other routes; confirm eligibility and the next cohort. Follow-on workspace funding is potential, not guaranteed.

opportunities.name: Black Entrepreneur Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Financing, mentorship and resources for young Black entrepreneurs starting or buying a Canadian business.
opportunities.eligibility: Self-identify as Black, be aged 18–39, a Canadian citizen or permanent resident living in Canada, and have a business not yet operating or operating full time for no more than 24 months. Additional ownership and business criteria apply.
opportunities.limits: Financing is a repayable loan, including BDC co-financing, not a grant; interest, fees and a personal credit check apply. Certain sectors and activities are excluded; review the provider’s eligibility list and current loan terms.

facts.Eligibility: Black founders aged 18–39; further criteria apply

opportunities.name: GIA London Acceleration Programme
opportunities.summary: Tech Nation delivers a market-entry programme connecting Singapore startups with UK partners and investors.
opportunities.eligibility: Singapore-based B2B or B2B2C tech startups; seed to Series B or clear client traction, Singapore incorporation and at least 30% qualifying local equity, plus further product and participation requirements.
opportunities.limits: Applications are closed; the provider accepts expressions of interest for future programmes. The described mission and benefits relate to a past intake; confirm future dates, costs and terms.

opportunities.name: Seed-Start Grant SA
opportunities.summary: Matched grants for early-stage South Australian businesses commercialising an innovative product or service.
opportunities.eligibility: Australian-incorporated company with an active ABN; non-tax-exempt and GST-registered; turnover below A$1 million in each of the prior three financial years; based, or willing to be based, in South Australia before the project starts.
opportunities.limits: Seed grants are A$50,000–A$100,000 at a 2:1 government-to-applicant match. Start grants are A$100,001–A$500,000 at a 1:1 match. Defined commercialisation projects and a unique product or sustainable competitive advantage are required; confirm current round terms.

facts.Geography: Based, or willing to be based, in South Australia

opportunities.name: First Nations Innovation Acceleration Program QLD
opportunities.value: Investment grants up to A$100,000 plus advisory services
opportunities.summary: Funding and dedicated business advisory support for established Queensland First Nations businesses developing innovative products or services.
opportunities.eligibility: A First Nations-owned business that is established and operating in Queensland, developing an innovative product or service, and seeking advisory support and possible funding to accelerate that innovation.
opportunities.limits: Applications close 4 February 2027, or earlier if fully subscribed. The source describes support for mature, established businesses, so this is a scale-up pathway rather than an idea-stage startup grant.

facts.Eligibility: First Nations-owned, established and operating in Queensland
facts.Closing date: 4 February 2027; may close earlier if fully subscribed

opportunities.name: Regional Artificial Intelligence Initiative — British Columbia
opportunities.summary: Federal project funding for qualifying B.C. businesses commercialising AI or integrating AI into operations.
opportunities.eligibility: Incorporated business operating in British Columbia: commercialization projects require at least 1 year of operation and 1–500 FTE; AI adoption projects require at least 3 years and 5–500 FTE.
opportunities.limits: Applications close 23 November 2026 at 12:00 pm Pacific. Interest-free repayable contribution covers up to 50% of eligible project costs; at least 50% of project funding must be confirmed from non-government sources. Routine off-the-shelf AI purchases are excluded. Repayment typically starts one year after project completion and runs monthly for five years.

facts.Funding: Repayable; up to 50% of eligible costs

opportunities.name: START — West of England
opportunities.org: TechSpark and West of England Mayoral Combined Authority
opportunities.value: Free 28-hour programme; possible funded incubator placement
opportunities.summary: Training, workshops and mentoring for people developing an early-stage technology business in the West of England.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicants must be over 18 and live in Bristol, South Gloucestershire or Bath and North East Somerset. For people with an idea, not yet trading, or within the first year of operating.
opportunities.limits: No new cohort dates are confirmed. The operator invites expressions of interest for future cohorts. A six-month funded incubator place is a possible outcome after pitching, not a guaranteed programme benefit.
opportunities.status: Future cohort dates unconfirmed; expressions of interest open

facts.Programme: 28 hours of learning, workshops and mentoring
facts.Location: Bristol, South Gloucestershire, or Bath and North East Somerset
facts.Next cohort: Dates not confirmed; expression of interest

opportunities.name: Pathways to Funding — North East England
opportunities.summary: Investor-readiness guidance for revenue-generating SMEs and innovation-driven businesses preparing to raise external finance.
opportunities.eligibility: A business or socially trading enterprise headquartered in Newcastle, Northumberland, or North Tyneside; aimed at revenue-generating SMEs and innovation-driven enterprises requiring external finance.
opportunities.limits: No grant or investment award is promised. Support includes workshops, one-to-one guidance, investor-readiness assessment and investor intelligence. GOV.UK lists start-ups with 1–2 years trading and established businesses; no closing date is stated.

facts.Support: Investor readiness workshops, one-to-one support, readiness levels, and investor intelligence

opportunities.name: AI Decision-Making Visibility and Compliance Governance Challenge
opportunities.org: Innovative Solutions Canada / Shared Services Canada
opportunities.value: Phase 2 prototype contract up to C$2,000,000
opportunities.summary: Federal challenge seeking an AI governance solution that tracks decision processes, output traceability and alignment with Canadian government requirements.
opportunities.eligibility: Canadian-incorporated, for-profit small business with 499 or fewer FTEs, conducting R&D in Canada and meeting ISC’s Canadian workforce and executive residency thresholds. This challenge accepts Phase 2 proposals for solutions at TRL 5–9.
opportunities.limits: Proposals close 22 December 2026 at 14:00 Eastern. This is a competitive Phase 2 prototype development contract, not an unconditional grant; the challenge is restricted to prototype-ready solutions and final award decisions depend on evaluation and available funding. Review the solicitation before applying.
opportunities.status: Open for proposals until 22 December 2026, 14:00 Eastern

facts.Maximum contract: C$2,000,000 before applicable taxes and expenses

opportunities.name: Female Founders Co-Investment Fund QLD
opportunities.summary: Queensland co-investment support for female-founded innovative businesses undertaking a pre-seed or seed capital raise.
opportunities.eligibility: Business headquartered and operating in Queensland with an active ABN and GST registration; at least 51% female-owned and female-led for at least six months; no more than 50 full-time-equivalent employees (FTEs), and not part of a group exceeding 50 FTEs. The business needs an innovative product beyond proof of concept and an investment plan or existing eligible investment offer.
opportunities.limits: Applications are open until 30 June 2027 or earlier if all funds are allocated. Funding supports a new pre-seed or seed raise; previous capital raises above A$500,000 disqualify. Confirm the required eligible-investor match and current round terms before applying.
opportunities.status: Open until 30 June 2027 or funds allocated

facts.Ownership and leadership: At least 51% female-owned and a woman in a primary executive role for at least six months

opportunities.name: Ignite Program NT
opportunities.value: A$2,000 planning voucher or up to A$15,000 for MVP/commercialisation
opportunities.summary: Northern Territory mentoring and pre-seed support through planning and competitive MVP-development streams.
opportunities.eligibility: Legal entity with a valid ABN that qualifies as a Territory Enterprise and is not an excluded applicant. Stream A is for an innovative idea addressing a market need with commercial potential. Stream B requires an Innovation Project Plan or equivalent, an eligible project budget and demonstrated delivery capacity.
opportunities.limits: Stream A: up to A$2,000 ex GST, paid to an approved Innovation Partner, first-come-first-served from a A$100,000 pool while funds remain; complete the plan within 3 months. Stream B: up to A$15,000 ex GST, competitive and subject to available funding, with up to 6 months to deliver. Excludes government agencies and controlled bodies, statutory corporations, schools/universities/other educational institutions, and applicants failing grant terms. Stream B cannot cover retrospective costs, ordinary operating costs, unrelated work, debt, land/buildings, expenses before approval or activities already funded by another government programme. Stream B Round 2 closes 30 November 2026; check the official page for later rounds.
opportunities.status: Stream A year-round; Stream B Round 2 closes 30 November 2026

facts.Stream A: Up to A$2,000 voucher paid to approved Innovation Partner
facts.Stream B: Up to A$15,000 ex GST, competitive

opportunities.name: Carbon Innovation Grants Program — Round 3
opportunities.org: Government of Western Australia — Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
opportunities.value: Feasibility: A$50,000–A$500,000 (up to 50%); pilot/capital works: A$100,000–A$1.5 million (up to 25%)
opportunities.summary: Competitive Western Australian grants for heavy-industry carbon-abatement or sequestration feasibility studies, pilot projects and capital works.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicant must have an ABN, GST registration, meet an eligible Australian entity type and fit-and-proper requirements. Project must be located in WA, or a feasibility study must be specific to WA sites; be new; support carbon abatement or sequestration and commercial viability; include at least one industrial business partner contributing cash or eligible in-kind support; and meet round and project timing rules.
opportunities.limits: Round 3 closes 11 December 2026 at 5pm AWST; around A$3.1 million is available. Existing projects already underway, business-as-usual activity, generic research not tied to heavy-industry facilities, projects without a WA site/location, renewable generation not directly supplying heavy industry on the same site, projects without an industrial business partner are ineligible, and projects intending to generate carbon credits outside WA or using methods ineligible under the Climate Active Carbon Neutral Standard are ineligible. Funding is competitive, paid by milestone in arrears, and is not guaranteed.

facts.Location: Western Australia: project site or WA-specific feasibility study
facts.Feasibility studies: A$50,000–A$500,000, up to 50% of eligible costs
facts.Pilot projects and capital works: A$100,000–A$1.5 million, up to 25% of eligible costs
facts.Industrial partner: At least one industrial business partner with cash or eligible in-kind contribution

opportunities.name: CSIRO ON Accelerate
opportunities.summary: A three-month commercialisation accelerator for teams translating Australian publicly funded research into a venture.
opportunities.eligibility: Teams of three to six, based in Australia, including an eligible Australian university or publicly funded research organisation researcher, or a PhD student or recent graduate; attendance and time commitments apply.
opportunities.limits: Selection includes an application, bootcamp and immersion; future delivery beyond the current funding period is uncertain. Confirm intake, dates and conditions.

opportunities.eligibility: Established South Australian small and medium businesses with an ABN and GST registration, and intent and opportunity to increase trade in Australian or international markets.
opportunities.limits: Participant contribution of $1,200 applies; programme is intended for established South Australian SMEs.
opportunities.name: Growth Accelerator Program SA
opportunities.org: South Australian Office for Small and Family Business
opportunities.summary: Nine-month growth programme with workshops, an assessment and 24 hours of mentoring for established South Australian businesses.
opportunities.value: Nine months of structured support and 24 hours of mentoring

opportunities.name: Supabase credits through AWS Activate
opportunities.summary: Application-based Supabase credits for eligible VC-backed startups using the AWS Activate route.
opportunities.eligibility: VC-backed; total funding below $5M; active AWS account; no prior redemption of this offer.
opportunities.limits: Approval required. Countries, expiry, activation deadline, stacking and post-credit billing terms are not stated on the offer page. Not general AWS compute credits.

facts.coverage: Any Supabase product; examples include database, auth, storage and edge functions.
facts.review: Published application review target: five business days.
